selected.title: MCP reference servers v2.1.0 security update
selected.summary: The official MCP reference-server repository released v2.1.0 with fixes for eight vulnerabilities across Filesystem, Everything and Fetch.
selected.availability: Filesystem and Everything 2.0.1 are published on npm; Fetch 2026.10.24 is published on PyPI.
selected.practical_use: Inventory MCP reference-server versions, explicitly install the patched packages and re-check allowed directories, origins and fetch boundaries before reconnecting clients.

source_review.excerpt: v2.1.0 fixes eight vulnerabilities in three servers.
source_review.decision: Signed release, package table, upgrade note, repository warning and linked advisories reviewed. The episode stays within the documented fixes.
source_review.availability: Patched npm and PyPI packages are published. The Filesystem fix remains partial on Windows, with a documented configuration constraint.

openai.reason: The October 22 Decisions API GA adds JSON input, question-specific images, shared-input caching and 400 questions. It materially extends episode 2026-10-08-decisions-routing but needs a separate GA migration and evaluation story.

anthropic.reason: The October 22 Anthropic-managed Google Cloud launch is available through Marketplace and IAM, but its cloud setup and organization boundary need a separate integration briefing.

google.reason: The newest Gemini API entry remains the October 13 Gemini 4 Argon GA, already covered by episode 2026-10-15-gemini-argon-api.

repositories.reason: The October 25 signed release fixes eight documented vulnerabilities in three reference servers and requires an explicit npm upgrade for older date-versioned installs.

architectures.reason: SPECMEM proposes live per-user tool-call memory with side-effect gating, but it is research-only and needs a full-paper architecture review.

editorial_review.context: repositories / builder / daily; MCP reference servers v2.1.0; event date 2026-10-25
editorial_review.viewer_question: Which MCP reference-server packages must a builder upgrade after v2.1.0, and what boundaries still need review?
editorial_review.prerequisites: An existing MCP-compatible client or deployment using the official Filesystem, Everything or Fetch reference packages, plus access to its package configuration.
editorial_review.central_task: Inventory installed versions, explicitly install the three fixed package versions, restart clients and review the remaining Windows and reference-only limits.
editorial_review.new_capability: The steering-group repository now publishes fixes for eight vulnerabilities across three MCP reference servers, with exact affected and patched versions.
editorial_review.closest_archive_coverage: All 19 episode files and confirmed receipts checked. Episode 2026-10-12-mcp-reference-servers introduced v1.0 evaluation and the reference-only boundary; it did not cover these October 25 fixes or the explicit date-version upgrade trap.
editorial_review.supported_payoff: Builders can identify whether their MCP reference packages are affected, apply exact fixed versions and avoid assuming that package managers will surface the npm update.
editorial_review.evidence_mode_reason: Documented upgrade walkthrough based on the signed GitHub release and advisories; no package execution or exploit reproduction.
editorial_review.alternatives: OpenAI Decisions GA and Anthropic-managed Claude on Google Cloud are strong but older October 22 changes that need separate evaluations. Google has no newer API entry. SPECMEM is research-only.
editorial_review.selection_rationale: The strongest verified 24-hour change is shipped, exact, actionable and a material correction to a repository covered earlier this month.
editorial_review.search_query: MCP reference servers v2.1.0 security fixes upgrade
editorial_review.final_verdict: approved after source review: the script identifies exact affected packages, explicit upgrade commands, the Windows residual limit and the lack of a live test.
editorial_review.metadata_review: The title and description name the exact release and upgrade task, distinguish documentation from testing and assign only the repositories playlist.

playlist_review.reason: The complete episode reviews one official AI repository release for builders: exact packages, fixed versions, upgrade steps and remaining limits.
